description: Static, market-compatible entry checks for DSH plugins. It is a pre-submit helper, not a gate, certification, ranking, or security audit.

checks.title: dsh.bundle with an existing patch file
FLOW J1 install/uninstall evidence (no longer an ENTRY gate)
Real entry declaration plus description (license/repository are advisories)

rules: C1/C3/C7 need --meta; without it they are not-run, never upgraded to pass.
C3 is flow-only: without --host-evidence it is not-applicable, not a missing ENTRY check. J1 is the required FLOW evidence.
A safety category other than clean/mentions-only is advisory A6; do not auto-run C3 for it.
C3 may use --host-evidence; pass/fail/blocked are preserved, and blocked is incomplete, never a pass.
C6 requires description and an entry declaration; a missing license is advisory A7 (legal/market profile), not a hard ENTRY fail.
C4 is a declared range; absent is a warning, not a hard failure. A too-wide/invalid range fails.
C5 is not-applicable without a client; a declared but uncommitted build output is a warning.
C6 checks the entry declaration and metadata; a declared but uncommitted build output is a warning.
C8 rejects grade/score/rank/official/certified/secure/recommended fields and non-reference claimLevel.
A pass here is not a market acceptance, certification, security audit, or quality ranking.
